plugins.name: Hornero Agenda
plugins.description: Desktop widget showing weekday, day and month, ISO week number, day of year and days remaining in the year, computed with pure Date math from PluginKit Time.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero AI Usage
plugins.description: AI Usage 2.0: bar indicator, provider switcher popover and dashboard card over the normalized horneroctl agent usage records. Quota is shown only when a provider record carries it; otherwise it is unknown.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Base Converter
plugins.description: Dashboard base converter: validated decimal integer within safe range to binary, octal and hex, and hex back to decimal. Invalid digits show errors. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Battery
plugins.description: Bar widget showing battery percentage and charging state from PluginKit Power. Shows 'No battery' on machines without a battery instead of a fabricated percentage.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Calculator
plugins.description: Dashboard calculator with a safe tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for +, -, *, /, %, parentheses, decimals and unary minus. Division by zero shows Error.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Calendar
plugins.description: Desktop widget showing the current date and time from the PluginKit Time service. Read-only, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Color Converter
plugins.description: Dashboard color converter: validated #RGB/#RRGGBB hex to RGB and HSL, and RGB inputs back to hex. Invalid hex shows an error. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Countdown
plugins.description: Countdown 2.0: compact bar countdown (5/10/25 presets) with a popover, progress, deadline-correct timing across sleep/reload and a completion toast. No sound, no processes, no network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultMinutes.description: Countdown length in minutes used until a preset is chosen.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

totalSeconds.description: Saved countdown length in seconds (0 means the default length). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full countdown). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

plugins.name: Hornero Date Calculator
plugins.description: Dashboard date calculator: validated YYYY-MM-DD real dates, days-between and add-days results using UTC math to avoid DST drift. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Disk Usage
plugins.description: Disk Usage 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit System.disks facade with per-disk used/total/free space, a most-full summary and near-full alerts. No invented SMART data. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Used percent at or above which a disk is flagged as nearly full.

showFreeSpace.description: Show free space under each disk (additive in 2.0) and the nearly-full hint.

plugins.name: Hornero Dual Clock
plugins.description: Local time next to UTC in the bar, for coordinating with people in other time zones. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Focus Card
plugins.description: A dashboard card with a rotating original one-line focus reminder and the date. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero JSON Tools
plugins.description: Dashboard JSON tools: Format with 2-space indentation and Minify using JSON parse/stringify only. Parser errors are shown. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Metronome
plugins.description: Metronome 2.0: compact bar metronome with a popover (BPM slider plus minus/plus), deadline-scheduled beats that skip missed beats after sleep, and optional first-beat accent. No processes, no network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

bpm.description: Metronome tempo in beats per minute (40-208).

beatsPerBar.description: Beats per bar used for the accented first beat.

accentFirstBeat.description: Flash the first beat of each bar in the accent colour.

plugins.name: Hornero Microphone
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for microphone state over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-input-device states. Never records audio.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showPercentage.description: Show the microphone volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSource.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no input device, when no source is present.

plugins.name: Hornero Moon Phase
plugins.description: Moon Phase 2.0: desktop widget and contextual bar indicator for the current moon phase, approximate illumination and derived next new/full moons from the 1.x pure-JS synodic approximation. Always labelled approximate.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showIllumination.description: Show the approximate illumination percentage (the 1.x behaviour).

showAge.description: Show the approximate moon age in days (the 1.x behaviour).

showNextPhases.description: Show approximate days to the next new and full moons, derived from the same synodic approximation.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only the phase name; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the approximation note.

plugins.name: Hornero Network Monitor
plugins.description: Network Monitor 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit Network facade with the 1.x speeds and session totals plus in-card history, peak readouts and honest unavailable states. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showSessionTotals.description: Show downloaded/uploaded session totals from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the in-card speed history sampled from the shared Network facade while the card is loaded.

sampleSeconds.description: Seconds between history samples read from the already-live shared Network facade.

plugins.name: Hornero Now Playing
plugins.description: Now Playing 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card over the shared PluginKit Media (MPRIS) facade, with graceful no-player and idle-player states.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showArtist.description: Show the track artist under the title when the player reports one.

showWhenNoPlayer.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no player, when no media player is active.

maxTitleWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels for the track title in the bar.

plugins.name: Hornero Pomodoro
plugins.description: Pomodoro 2.0: compact bar focus timer with a popover, deadline-correct timing across sleep/reload, a typed session-length setting and a completion toast. No processes, no network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full session). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

plugins.name: Hornero Quick Notes
plugins.description: Dashboard card with one persistent note saved through PluginKit Settings. Text is loaded on start, saved debounced, counted, and truncated at 4096 characters.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Quiet Notes
plugins.description: A calm dashboard card for one short intention for this session. It keeps no history and writes nowhere; when the shell closes, the note is gone.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Stopwatch
plugins.description: Stopwatch 2.0: compact bar stopwatch with a popover, wall-clock-anchored elapsed time correct across sleep/reload and an optional tenths display. Pure QML, no processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showTenths.description: Show tenths of a second in the elapsed time.

accumulatedMs.description: Saved elapsed milliseconds while paused. Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

startedEpochMs.description: Saved start anchor in epoch milliseconds (0 when paused). Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Audio
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: bar indicator, popover and dashboard card for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state from the typed horneroctl contract. Read-only; mode changes stay in the CLI and Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between studio mode refreshes from horneroctl.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as unavailable, when horneroctl returns no usable studio mode.

plugins.name: Hornero Studio Jobs
plugins.description: Render and export job monitor for HorneroOS Studio: shows queued, running, finished and interrupted jobs from the typed horneroctl studio jobs contract. Read-only; jobs are submitted and cancelled from the CLI or Control Center.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Sun Card
plugins.description: Sun Card 2.0: dashboard astronomy card and contextual bar indicator with sunrise/sunset from PluginKit Weather plus derived day length, sun progress and next sun event. Approximations are labelled derived.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showTemperature.description: Show temperature and description from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showAstronomy.description: Show astronomy detail derived from sunrise/sunset: day length, sun progress and the next sun event.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only sunrise/sunset; standard keeps the 1.x rows plus astronomy; detailed adds the unavailable-fields note.

plugins.name: Hornero System Health
plugins.description: System Health 2.0: dashboard health summary over the shared PluginKit System, Power and Network facades, with per-row health states, thresholds and troubleshooting hints. No invented SMART data.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a CPU, memory or storage row needs attention.

batteryWarnPercent.description: Battery percent at or below which a discharging battery needs attention.

showNetwork.description: Show the download/upload rows from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHints.description: Show a short troubleshooting hint under rows that need attention.

plugins.name: Hornero System Monitor
plugins.description: System Monitor 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit System facade with the 1.x usage bars plus in-card session history, peak/average readouts and a high-load alert. Read-only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a row is flagged as high. Adds an alert chip only; 1.x had no threshold.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures when the System service reports them (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the in-card session history sampled from the shared System facade while the card is loaded.

sampleSeconds.description: Seconds between history samples read from the already-live shared System facade.

plugins.name: Hornero Text Tools
plugins.description: Dashboard text tools: Uppercase, Lowercase, Title Case and Reverse transforms with live character, word and line counts. Pure QML.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Unit Converter
plugins.description: Dashboard unit converter for length (m, km, mi, ft), mass (kg, lb) and temperature (C, F, K). Pure-JS conversions computed live from a text field and unit selectors. No processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Uptime
plugins.description: Bar widget showing system uptime read from /proc/uptime with the declared cat command, refreshed every 60 seconds. Shows an error state when uptime is unreadable instead of a fabricated zero.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

plugins.name: Hornero Volume
plugins.description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for output volume over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-output-device states.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

showPercentage.description: Show the output volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSink.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no output device, when no sink is present.

plugins.name: Hornero Weather
plugins.description: Weather 2.0: dashboard card and contextual bar indicator complementing native Weather with configurable density, a local wind-threshold alert and forecast detail from the PluginKit Weather facade only.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors

forecastDays.description: Forecast entries to show (the 1.x card showed the first 3).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showWind.description: Show wind speed in km/h when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showSunTimes.description: Show sunrise and sunset times from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

dataDensity.description: compact shows only temperature and description; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the derived forecast range.

windAlertKmh.description: Local high-wind alert threshold in km/h. Not an official alert; 1.x had no threshold.

plugins.name: Hornero World Clock
plugins.description: Dashboard card showing local time, UTC, and Buenos Aires, Madrid and Tokyo. Times use pure-JS offsets (Madrid follows the EU DST rule); each row is labelled with its applied UTC offset. No processes or network.
plugins.author: HorneroOS contributors
